title: The Cursed Tome
description: The Ashgrave Cantos went missing from the restricted shelf three nights ago, and the boy who catalogued it hasn't stopped shaking since. It isn't dangerous the way a sword is dangerous - the last person who read from it aloud without training lost the rest of that week. The cultists west of town took it for a reason. I need to know what that reason is before they finish reading it.

objectives.description: Find the cultist temple west of Dalhurst - do not go in blind

notes: Threat: a grimoire that costs an untrained reader their wits is loose in a cult's hands. Giver motive: the scholar catalogued it, feels responsible, and doesn't trust the city watch to treat a book as a threat. Consequence of refusal: unwired - the cult keeps reading from it. Invented: the tome's name (Ashgrave Cantos) and the shaken cataloguer boy - no bible basis, local colour.
